articles.title: US envoys head to meet Zelensky after talks with Putin in Moscow
articles.description: US envoy Steve Witkoff says President Putin has agreed to European negotiators joining the next round of Ukraine talks.
articles.titleJa: 米国特使、モスクワでプーチン大統領と会談後、ゼレンスキー大統領と面会へ
articles.summary: 米国特使がモスクワでプーチン大統領と会談後、ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領と面会予定。プーチン大統領は次回のウクライナ協議に欧州交渉担当者が参加することに同意した。

articles.title: Russian warship hit by Ukrainian drone in Gulf of Finland
articles.description: The attack is thought to be the first time Ukrainian drones have attacked a Russian ship in an open stretch of the Baltic Sea.
articles.titleJa: ロシア軍艦、フィンランド湾でウクライナのドローン攻撃を受ける
articles.summary: ロシア軍艦がフィンランド湾でウクライナのドローン攻撃を受けたとされる。バルト海の開けた海域でウクライナのドローンがロシア艦を攻撃したのは初めてとみられる。

articles.title: Suspected bomb hoax threats force fresh evacuations of Italian schools
articles.description: Schools across Italy have received bomb threats for the second day in a row, sparking fresh panic and evacuations.
articles.titleJa: 爆弾を装った脅迫でイタリアの学校が再び避難
articles.summary: イタリア全土の学校が2日連続で爆弾脅迫を受け、新たなパニックと避難が発生している。

articles.title: Democrat Scott Colom makes history as Mississippi's first black senator since 19th Century
articles.description: In a state Trump won two years ago by 22 points, Colom's victory extends a string of Democratic wins in the Senate.
articles.titleJa: 民主党のスコット・コラム氏、ミシシッピ州初の19世紀以来の黒人上院議員として歴史を作る
articles.summary: 民主党のスコット・コラム氏がミシシッピ州で勝利し、19世紀以来初の黒人上院議員に。トランプ氏が22ポイント差で勝利した州での民主党の連勝を拡大した。

articles.title: Hegseth awards medal to war memorial guard who reprimanded him and group
articles.description: Specialist Thomas Iglesias was given a Joint Service Commendation Medal for the execution of his duties after Wednesday's incident.
articles.titleJa: ヘグセス氏、自身とグループを叱責した戦没者慰霊碑の警備員にメダルを授与
articles.summary: 水曜日の事件後、職務を遂行したトーマス・イグレシアス専門官に統合軍表彰メダルが授与された。

articles.title: Millions of Ebola dollars missing with staff unpaid while virus spreads, charity says
articles.description: Medical staff are going unpaid, lack proper training and are struggling with shortages of essential supplies, MSF warns
articles.titleJa: エボラ支援金数百万ドルが行方不明、ウイルス蔓延中にスタッフは無給と慈善団体が発表
articles.summary: 国境なき医師団（MSF）は、医療スタッフが無給で、適切な訓練を受けておらず、必要な物資が不足していると警告した。

articles.title: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills six Palestinians, health ministry says
articles.description: Witnesses say a missile hit a building containing the surgical wards and intensive care units at Nasser hospital, the largest in southern Gaza.
articles.titleJa: イスラエル軍のガザ病院攻撃でパレスチナ人6人死亡、保健省発表
articles.summary: イスラエル軍のガザ病院への攻撃でパレスチナ人6人が死亡したと保健省が発表。目撃者によると、ミサイルがガザ南部最大の病院、ナセル病院の外科病棟と集中治療室のある建物に命中した。

articles.title: Five new miniature frog species found in eastern Himalayas
articles.description: Scientists say the frogs evolved as the Himalayas rose and the Asian monsoon took shape.
articles.titleJa: 東ヒマラヤで新種の小型カエル5種を発見
articles.summary: 科学者たちは、ヒマラヤ山脈の隆起とアジアモンスーンの形成に伴ってカエルが進化したと述べている。

articles.title: Oranges investigated after four girls die in suspected Uganda school poisoning
articles.description: The girls started vomiting after eating oranges brought in by a fellow pupil - police are travelling to the village they came from.
articles.titleJa: ウガンダの学校で女児4人死亡、毒物混入の疑いでオレンジを調査
articles.summary: ウガンダの学校で女児4人が死亡。同級生が持ってきたオレンジを食べた後、嘔吐し始めたため、警察は彼女たちが来た村に向かっている。

articles.title: Eight killed in Colombian air strike targeting Gulf Clan gang
articles.description: A suspected gang leader considered a "priority target" was among those killed, the Colombian president says.
articles.titleJa: コロンビアの空爆でガルフ・クランギャングを標的、8人死亡
articles.summary: コロンビアの空爆でガルフ・クランギャングを標的とし、8人が死亡。コロンビア大統領は「優先標的」とされたギャングのリーダーが死亡者の中に含まれると発表した。

articles.title: Microsoft reports mass outages in US, impacting customer accessibility
articles.description: Software giant Microsoft has reported widespread outages of its Outlook and Teams services in the US. Nearly 130,000 users have reported disruptions.
articles.titleJa: マイクロソフトが米国で大規模な障害を報告、顧客のアクセスに影響
articles.summary: ソフトウェア大手マイクロソフトが、米国でOutlookとTeamsサービスの大規模な障害を報告。約13万人のユーザーに影響が出ています。

articles.title: Pete Hegseth honors soldier who scolded him at Arlington cemetery
articles.description: The soldier had reprimanded the US Defense Secretary and his group after they were heard talking and laughing at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier. The site is one of the most solemn military memorials in the US.
articles.titleJa: ピート・ヘグセス、アーリントン墓地で彼を叱責した兵士を称える
articles.summary: 米国の国防長官とその一行が、無名戦士の墓で談笑していたところを兵士にたしなめられ、ヘグセス氏がその兵士を称賛しました。

articles.title: Nigeria: Axe-wielding men attack opposition campaign rally in Lagos
articles.description: A group of men armed with axes, clubs and machetes have reportedly attacked an opposition rally in the run-up to presidential elections. Journalists were also attacked as victims pointed fingers at the ruling APC party.
articles.titleJa: ナイジェリア：ラゴスで斧を携えた男たちが野党の選挙集会を襲撃
articles.summary: 大統領選挙を控え、ナイジェリアのラゴスで斧などを持った男たちが野党集会を襲撃。ジャーナリストも標的となり、与党APCが非難されています。

articles.title: Czechia braces for massive protest as anger over government's public media reform plans boils
articles.description: A fast-tracked bill on public media funding reform has sparked strikes, rallies and fears for the independence of public broadcasting in Czechia. A massive protest is due to take place in Prague on November 15.
articles.titleJa: チェコ、政府の公共メディア改革計画に対する怒りで大規模な抗議活動を準備
articles.summary: チェコで公共メディア資金改革法案が物議を醸し、ストライキや集会が発生。11月15日にプラハで大規模な抗議が予定されています。

articles.title: Can the EU make it harder to trick consumers online?
articles.description: The EU wants to curb subscription traps, misleading sales tactics and features that keep people scrolling. What would the proposed Digital Fairness Act change, and does it go far enough?
articles.titleJa: EUはオンラインで消費者を騙すことをより困難にできるか？
articles.summary: EUはオンラインでの消費者の欺瞞を防ぐためのデジタル公正法を提案。サブスクリプション詐欺や誤解を招く販売戦術の抑制を目指しています。

articles.title: Mercedes-Benz halts all further investment at German facilities
articles.description: The announcement comes as the luxury German automaker faces increasing pressure from the works council and trade unions.
articles.titleJa: メルセデス・ベンツ、ドイツ国内施設へのさらなる投資を停止
articles.summary: ドイツの高級自動車メーカー、メルセデス・ベンツが、労働組合からの圧力により、ドイツ国内施設への新規投資を停止すると発表しました。

articles.title: What have the talks with Russia and the US in Abu Dhabi achieved for Ukraine?
articles.description: The first trilateral talks between Ukraine, the US and Russia in nine months have ended with an agreement on exchanging prisoners. Does this mark a genuine breakthrough and a step toward peace?
articles.titleJa: アブダビでのロシアと米国の会談はウクライナにとって何を達成したか？
articles.summary: ウクライナ、米国、ロシアの三者会談が捕虜交換の合意で終了。9ヶ月ぶりの交渉は平和への一歩となるか注目されています。

articles.title: Hungary eases abortion restrictions in women's rights overhaul
articles.description: The reforms mark a break the the conservative policies of former PM Viktor Orban. The controversial "heartbeat regulation" is to be scrapped and women are to be better protected against violence.
articles.titleJa: ハンガリー、女性の権利改革で中絶規制を緩和
articles.summary: ハンガリーが女性の権利改革の一環として中絶規制を緩和。物議を醸した「心拍規制」が撤廃され、女性の保護強化が図られます。

articles.title: Sri Lanka: Rights groups sound alarm over proposed anti-terror law
articles.description: The Sri Lankan government is looking to replace a controversial anti-terror law, but critics say the new one is just as bad.
articles.titleJa: スリランカ：人権団体が新たなテロ対策法案に警鐘
articles.summary: スリランカ政府が新たなテロ対策法案を検討中ですが、人権団体は既存の法と同様に問題が多いと指摘し、懸念を表明しています。

articles.title: UK court convicts 2 Iranian men of spying on journalists
articles.description: A London court has found two Iranian citizens guilty of surveilling reporters for a Persian-language television station critical of Iran's government. One was also convicted of planning a violent attack against them.
articles.titleJa: 英国の裁判所、ジャーナリストをスパイしたイラン人2人に有罪判決
articles.summary: ロンドンの裁判所が、イラン政府に批判的なペルシャ語テレビ局の記者を監視したイラン人2人に有罪判決。1人は暴力的な攻撃計画でも有罪となりました。

articles.title: Zimbabwean author Simbarashe Kundizeza cleared of using AI to write prize-winning story
articles.description:
After a month-long investigation it was concluded that Kundizeza’s story The Blue Fighter, which won the £10,000 Caine prize, was ‘human-written’
The Zimbabwean author Simbarashe Kundizeza has been cleared of using AI to write a prize-winning short story, after the prestigious Caine prize for African writers concluded that his entry was “human-written” after a month-long investigation.
Kundizeza’s story The Blue Fighter, which charts the declining fortunes of a family after the father invests in fish tanks, was announced as the winner of the £10,000 prize on 6 October.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ジンバブエの作家シンバラシェ・クンディゼザ、受賞作にAI使用の疑いが晴れる
articles.summary: ジンバブエの作家シンバラシェ・クンディゼザ氏の受賞作について、AI使用の疑いが調査の結果「人間が執筆した」と結論付けられ、疑惑が晴れた。

articles.title: Lewis Hamilton visits Egypt’s Rafah crossing and Gaza aid facilities
articles.description:
Seven-time F1 world champion tours border area and logistics warehouses operated by Egyptian Red Crescent
Lewis Hamilton has visited Egypt’s Rafah border crossing with the Gaza Strip to meet organisations sending humanitarian aid to the territory.
The seven-time Formula One world champion has spoken out about conflict and humanitarian crises in the region, and has called for peace. He has frequently posted on social media about children killed in Israeli airstrikes in Gaza and called for a ceasefire.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ルイス・ハミルトン、エジプトのラファ検問所とガザ援助施設を訪問
articles.summary: F1世界チャンピオンのルイス・ハミルトンがエジプトのラファ国境検問所を訪問し、ガザ地区への人道支援団体と面会した。

articles.title: Collision of two trains in Egypt kills at least seven
articles.description:
President orders prompt investigation after one train derails in collision in al-Ayyat about 50km from Cairo
Seven people were killed and at least 125 injured when two trains collided on Sunday south of the Egyptian capital, Cairo, officials said.
The crash occurred in al-Ayyat district in Giza province, about 50km (30 miles) south of Cairo, when a train travelling to Fayoum province crashed into the rear of a train heading to the southern province of Aswan, according to the transport ministry.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: エジプトで列車2台が衝突、少なくとも7人死亡
articles.summary: エジプトのカイロ南方で列車2台が衝突し、少なくとも7人が死亡、125人以上が負傷した。大統領は迅速な調査を命じた。

articles.title: How African philosophies inspired a new approach to staging film festivals in Manchester
articles.description:
See My World, an event highlighting the pan-African thought via film, poetry and dance, builds on momentum sparked by local activists and creatives
African philosophies including exploring how lessons from the past can shape the present and near future have inspired a film festival coming to Manchester.
See My World, a day dedicated to independent creators from across the African diaspora in the north of England, will take place at the Contact theatre on 21 November.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: アフリカの哲学がマンチェスターでの映画祭開催に新たなアプローチをもたらした経緯
articles.summary: アフリカの哲学にインスパイアされた映画祭「See My World」がマンチェスターで開催され、アフリカ系ディアスポラのクリエイターに焦点を当てる。

articles.title: Kenyan doomsday sect leader jailed for 200 years for murder of 190 children
articles.description:
Paul Mackenzie convicted over deaths of children and one adult after followers were ordered to starve themselves and their families
The leader of a Kenyan doomsday sect has been sentenced to 200 years in prison for the murders of 190 children and one adult in one of the world’s worst cult disasters in recent history.
The sentence, comprising 100 years for murder by starvation and 100 years by direct homicide, came two weeks after the court in Kenya’s coastal city of Mombasa found the cult leader guilty of the crimes.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ケニアの終末論カルト指導者、子供190人殺害で200年の禁固刑
articles.summary: ケニアの終末論カルト指導者が、信者に餓死を命じ、子供190人を含む殺害で200年の禁固刑を言い渡された。

articles.title: Two skulls likely belonging to enslaved people returned to Brazil after Harvard used them in eugenics studies
articles.description:
Remains believed to have belonged to Africans or Afro-Brazilians repatriated after being flown back by diplomats 
Two skulls, including that of a man believed to have taken part in Brazil’s greatest slave revolt but whose remains were taken to the United States and used in racist eugenics studies at Harvard University, were repatriated on Wednesday.
The remains had been outside Brazil since the 19th century. One was taken about 190 years ago from Salvador, the capital of the state of Bahia; the other, about 160 years ago, from Rio de Janeiro – and were welcomed back in moving, subdued ceremonies in both cities.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ハーバード大学の優生学研究に使用された奴隷の頭蓋骨2個がブラジルに返還される
articles.summary: ハーバード大学で優生学研究に使用された奴隷のものとみられる頭蓋骨2個が、約190年ぶりにブラジルに返還された。

articles.title: Ex-member of radical Marxist group scales balcony, escapes house arrest in Argentina
articles.description:
Leonardo Bertulazzi, 74, awaiting extradition to Italy, reportedly used harness to flee custody
A 74-year-old former member of Italy’s radical Marxist group the Red Brigades has escaped from house arrest in Argentina, the country’s security ministry confirmed on Wednesday, after he reportedly hid his ankle monitor inside a tube of pork and lowered himself from a fifth-floor balcony.
Authorities placed Leonardo Bertulazzi under house arrest in Buenos Aires in 2024, prior to his extradition to Italy to serve a 27-year prison sentence. He had received the sentence in 1987 for joining a subversive association and belonging to an armed group.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 元過激派マルクス主義グループのメンバー、アルゼンチンで自宅軟禁から脱走
articles.summary: イタリアの過激派マルクス主義グループ「赤い旅団」の元メンバーが、アルゼンチンでの自宅軟禁から脱走したと報じられた。

articles.title: Argentinian lawyer mocks UK’s sovereignty claim in Falklands oil case
articles.description:
Lawyer says Britain wrong to believe in historic doctrine that crown has sovereignty over parts of oceans
Britain should not be permitted to act as a 17th-century colonial power treating the waters around the Falkland Islands as a Dominium maris Britannici, Argentina has told an international tribunal.
Marcelo Kohen, representing Argentina at a hearing in Hamburg, mocked Britain for apparently believing in the historic doctrine that the British crown has sovereignty over expansive parts of the oceans.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: アルゼンチンの弁護士、フォークランド諸島油田訴訟における英国の主権主張を嘲笑
articles.summary: アルゼンチンは、フォークランド諸島周辺海域における英国の主権主張を国際法廷で批判。英国の主張を17世紀の植民地主義と揶揄した。

articles.title: Killing of journalist underscores deteriorating conditions in Ecuador
articles.description:
Tomás Beltrán was shot dead amid gang warfare that has turned Latin American country into one of its most violent
Tomás Beltrán was manoeuvring his car into his garage on Sunday night when the Ecuadorian journalist was shot dead.
Beltrán ran a Facebook page with news about Calceta, a small city in the province of Manabí, whose Pacific coastline has made it a key flashpoint in the gang warfare over drug trafficking routes that has transformed one of Latin America’s safest countries into one of its most violent.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ジャーナリスト殺害がエクアドルの悪化する治安状況を浮き彫りに
articles.summary: エクアドルのジャーナリスト、トマス・ベルトランが殺害された事件は、同国がラテンアメリカで最も暴力的な国の一つになった現状を示す。

articles.title: Falkland Islanders face ‘devastating consequences’ if Argentina blocks oil project, says UK
articles.description:
Countries clash over Sea Lion project as Hamburg tribunal risks deepening sovereignty dispute
The people of the Falkland Islands face “devastating consequences” if Argentina is successful in blocking development of its offshore oilfield, the attorney general for England and Wales has told an international tribunal.
Ellie Reeves, representing the British government at a hearing of the international tribunal for the law of the sea (Itlos), said billions of pounds vital to the future of the British overseas territory would be lost.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: アルゼンチンが石油プロジェクトを阻止すれば、フォークランド諸島住民は「壊滅的な結果」に直面すると英国が警告
articles.summary: 英国政府は、アルゼンチンがフォークランド諸島の沖合油田開発を阻止すれば、住民は壊滅的な影響を受けると国際法廷で主張した。

articles.title: Huang's exit, AI bubble and financial crisis fears in focus on Web Summit's last day
articles.description: Jensen Huang's resignation as Nvidia CEO, the risk of an AI bubble and soaring US debt were in focus on a packed last day of the Web Summit in Lisbon, as speakers on a panel moderated by Euronews warned that public debt markets could trigger the next financial crisis.
articles.titleJa: ウェブサミット最終日、ファン氏の退任、AIバブル、金融危機の懸念が焦点に
articles.summary: ウェブサミットの最終日、NvidiaのファンCEO退任、AIバブル、米国債務が焦点となり、公的債務市場が次の金融危機を引き起こす可能性が警告されました。

articles.title: Nvidia without Huang 'a significant loss' and puts the AI boom under a microscope, say economists
articles.description: Speaking at Web Summit Lisbon, one economist calls founder Jensen Huang’s exit “a critical mistake” and a “significant loss” for the industry, while another says large corporations are built to outlast the people who run them.
articles.titleJa: ファン氏抜きのNvidiaは「大きな損失」であり、AIブームを精査するとエコノミストが発言
articles.summary: ウェブサミット・リスボンで、エコノミストは創設者ジェンスン・ファン氏の退任を「致命的な間違い」とし、AIブームを精査する必要があると述べました。

articles.title: Microsoft outage hits Outlook, Teams and Copilot, disrupting thousands
articles.description: Microsoft services outage: thousands of users report issues with Outlook, Teams and Copilot. The company is working to restore services.
articles.titleJa: Microsoftのサービス障害、Outlook、Teams、Copilotに影響、数千人に混乱
articles.summary: Microsoftのサービス障害により、Outlook、Teams、Copilotに問題が発生し、数千人のユーザーに影響が出ています。復旧作業が進行中です。

articles.title: Mercedes-Benz halts new investment in German plants, considers closures
articles.description: The Stuttgart carmaker is temporarily halting all further investment at its German sites. Possible plant closures are looming, increasing pressure on staff, works council and IG Metall. Volkswagen and Audi have also announced major savings programmes.
articles.titleJa: メルセデス・ベンツ、ドイツ工場への新規投資を停止、閉鎖を検討
articles.summary: メルセデス・ベンツはドイツ工場への新規投資を一時停止し、閉鎖の可能性も検討しており、従業員と労働組合に圧力がかかっています。

articles.title: Russia and Iran criticise US Caspian task force as study outlines joint sanction evasion
articles.description: After CENTCOM affirmed it would maintain the naval blockade of the Strait of Hormuz and block the IRGC’s land and Caspian routes, Russia called this special taskforce a 'clear violation of international law'. At the same time, the Institute for the Study of War devoted its latest assessment to Tehran-Moscow cooperation in circumventing US arms restrictions.
articles.titleJa: ロシアとイラン、米国カスピ海タスクフォースを批判、共同制裁回避が明らかに
articles.summary: 米国がホルムズ海峡とIRGCの海上ルート封鎖を維持すると表明した後、ロシアは米国カスピ海タスクフォースを「国際法違反」と非難しました。

articles.title: FIFA president says Qatar safe for U-17 World Cup despite US withdrawal
articles.description: Gianni Infantino and local organisers say preparations are continuing for the 19 November kick-off of the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026 tournament, with FIFA expected to decide on a replacement for the US team. US Soccer decided to withdraw its team based on US travel advisories for the region.
articles.titleJa: FIFA会長、米国撤退にもかかわらずU-17ワールドカップのカタール開催は安全と発言
articles.summary: FIFA会長は、米国チームの撤退にもかかわらず、FIFA U-17ワールドカップ・カタール2026の準備は順調に進んでおり、カタールは安全だと述べました。

articles.title: Russia plays down peace talks with Europe after Witkoff raises hopes of breakthrough
articles.description: After Steve Witkoff raised hopes that Europeans and Russians would soon sit at the same time, Moscow minimised the prospect and said Europe should cease military support for Ukraine.
articles.titleJa: ロシア、ウィトコフ氏の突破口への期待を裏切り、欧州との和平協議を軽視
articles.summary: スティーブ・ウィトコフ氏が欧州とロシアの和平協議への期待を高めた後、モスクワはその見通しを軽視し、ウクライナへの軍事支援停止を求めました。

articles.title: France to spearhead new AI defence resilience centre with partner nations
articles.description: The centre will be based the northwestern French city of Rennes and aims to gain NATO recognition, according to France's Ministry of Armed Forces.
articles.titleJa: フランス、パートナー国と共に新たなAI防衛レジリエンスセンターを主導へ
articles.summary: フランスはレンヌに新たなAI防衛レジリエンスセンターを設立し、NATOの承認を得ることを目指しています。

articles.title: “The rules-based international order is breaking down,” Thailand’s Foreign Minister warns
